title: Christian Monasticism — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Monastic communities, from Benedictine abbeys to Orthodox monasteries, devote life to prayer, work, and study. The Rule of Saint Benedict, written in the sixth century, still guides Western monastic life. This overview edition presents Christian Monasticism within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
